contribution: An Italian cardinal deacon and later a condottiero, as well as a member of the Spanish House of Borgia.

checks.lead: Cesare Borgia (13 September 1475 – 12 March 1507) was an Italian cardinal deacon and later a condottiero, as well as a member of the Spanish House of Borgia. He was the illegitimate son of Pope Alexander VI and sibling to Lucrezia Borgia.
